281227503.description:
Product Overview:
This lot includes a variety of rough and polished mineral and fossil specimens. The collection features different types of quartz, agate, and other semi-precious stones, along with fossil specimens such as a crinoid and a septarian nodule. Included are small labeled sample bags marked 'Petrified Wood' and 'Crinoid' with informational cards. The assortment contains a blue agate slice, tumbled and raw stones in various shapes, and circular cut cabochons in natural colors including white, pink, gray, brown, and blue.

Specifications:
- Mineral Types: Quartz, Agate, Semi-Precious Stones
- Fossil Types: Crinoid, Septarian Nodule
- Sample Bags: Labeled 'Petrified Wood' and 'Crinoid' with informational cards
- Stone Forms: Rough, Polished, Tumbled, Cabochons
- Colors: White, Pink, Gray, Brown, Blue
- Total Weight: 6 pounds

Crystal Mineral Specimen Lot - 15+ Pieces
Natural Stone Collection
Multi-Color, Modern Decor
This diverse collection of natural mineral specimens features a variety of popular stones in various cuts and finishes, from polished towers to raw druzy slabs. Each piece showcases the unique geological formations and characteristic colors associated with high-quality decor crystals, making this an ideal starter set for collectors or a versatile decorative arrangement.
Pieces Included:
Rose Quartz Tower - Hexagonal point, translucent pale pink, polished finish
Amethyst Tower - Polished point with characteristic purple and white banding
Labradorite Palm Stone - Polished oval stone exhibiting blue-green labradorescence
Agate Druzy Slabs (2) - Natural edge butterfly-style wings with crystalline centers
Glass Bottle - Tumbled amethyst and mixed stone chips with white screw cap
Small Quartz Point - Clear crystal point with natural termination
Amethyst Rough Lot - Several unpolished raw amethyst chunks in varying purple hues
Condition:
